T0582.title: CDN Cache Key
T0582.definition: The request attributes used by a CDN to decide whether two requests map to the same cached object.
T0582.description: A CDN cache key determines which requests map to the same cached object. If host, path, query parameters, headers, or authentication context are not included correctly, user-specific content can be mixed, poisoned, or cached inappropriately. Controls focus on cache-policy review and isolation of dynamic content.
T0582.usageExample: Assess CDN Cache Key related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
